title: Old Republic Releases 2025 Sustainability Report
summary: Old Republic International’s Sustainability Report provides a view inside our organization beyond traditional financial disclosure.
body_markdown:
At Old Republic, adaptability and innovation are built on a foundation of responsible stewardship. When we issue a policy, we are making a promise to our customers. Old Republic International’s Sustainability Report provides a view inside our organization beyond traditional financial disclosure.


Click[here](https://www.oldrepublictitle.com/Media/kvho0mbc/2025-sustainability-report_final.pdf) to learn more about our Company culture, our commitment to our stakeholders and our shared future.
